title: Execute the actual FOUR packet boundary with a complete payload bill
body:
This constructive reference closes physical packet ordering and owned output installation for the actual FOUR/base event8814, family65689. It composes the retained sequential monomial routines, at most three ordering swaps per column, one abstract child call, inverse ordering and output retirement. Payload writes are append-only. The source input and dirty borrowed words survive normal return. This replaces the predecessor's address-tagged payload reindexing with an executed tape path.

The [proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6c05f188c9d21ab6f6818b30627d5c899b13aae8/research/four-packet-sequential-boundary/PROOF.md), [exact receipt](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6c05f188c9d21ab6f6818b30627d5c899b13aae8/research/four-packet-sequential-boundary/RESULT.json) and [source manifest](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6c05f188c9d21ab6f6818b30627d5c899b13aae8/research/four-packet-sequential-boundary/SOURCES.json) define the scope. For payload V, old output W, f columns, affine word lengths w_R,w_L and g ordering swaps, the wrapper has exactly `18V[f(w_R+w_L+4)+2g]+15V+3W` payload transitions, with g<=3f. Child work, descriptor production, continuation and polynomial control arithmetic have separate charges. The resulting O(Vf+W) path **does not close the sublinear node allowance** and does not improve the complete kappa calculation.

The uniform proof retains all inactive, remainder and spectator axes, but uses the source fixture's native chart d that swaps axes 0 and 1. The recursive child and scalar compiler identity remain explicit contracts. Arbitrary covers, helpers and other provider classes are outside the implementation. Failed callbacks have no rollback guarantee.

Base: canonical main `7c472563474e60185e6ca101a17622133d047e56`, priority revision 7. @JoyboyBrian supplied the actual request, chart distinction and packet proof in [PR #5327](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5327), retained head `e95b239ebcbfe6e0a45b4ee89de13115fb5b85a1`. @jmbarrancoml supplied the sequential primitives in [PR #2250](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2250). The consumed [primitive proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c472563474e60185e6ca101a17622133d047e56/research/selected-complex-compact-adapters/PROOF.md) retains Douglas Colkitt's construction. Cinna Davis, unpaidmoon, Matarener and the native/Clifford lineage keep their credit in the [packet source](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c472563474e60185e6ca101a17622133d047e56/research/complex-four-base-packet/README.md).

Use CPython 3.12 with no third-party packages, from the repository root:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/four-packet-sequential-boundary
```

Expected status: `PASS_FOUR_PACKET_SEQUENTIAL_BOUNDARY_NO_NEW_KAPPA`. Normal and optimized 3.12.13, optimized 3.14.7, committed-byte checks, the official 16-file export and a Git-free optimized replay passed. A corrupted source is rejected. Checks cover three 1024-record executions with a nontrivial Walsh calibration child and unequal old output lengths; a complete 262144-record two-column execution with one identity child; 27 distinct-record ordering tests; and nine controls. The independent source oracle agrees at every output. Measured wrapper operations equal the invoice, including 38830080 transitions for the first empty-output fixture; child work is additional.

The calibration children are not production C. No full 147-bit payload, helper/provider census, native replay, Lean, Docker, selected cold replay or complete multiplier was run. Optional full-history checks are unavailable in this shallow checkout. A faster compact/group-ordering implementation and full caller integration remain open. The selected frontier is unchanged. Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. No independent human or proof-kernel review is claimed.
